critique.evidence: The injection control and header pass the supplied keyboard checks with visible focus; no section touch-target or viewport-overflow violations were measured; reduced-motion sampling found no changed elements. However, contrast remains unverified with serious incomplete results: 40 nodes in the injection section and 14–26 header nodes, including headings, body copy, labels, badges, and navigation. At tablet/mobile widths, 21/27 header overflow candidates are clipped, with later navigation items visually off-screen despite keyboard reachability. No assistive-technology or switch-state announcement evidence was supplied.
critique.fix: Provide measured contrast ratios over the actual gradient backgrounds and remediate all failures to WCAG AA. Redesign or clearly expose the tablet/mobile header overflow so every destination is discoverable and operable visually. Verify the switch’s name, role, state changes, and revealed-content announcement with a screen reader, then rerun axe, keyboard, touch-target, overflow, and reduced-motion tests.
